verdict.rationale: Algolia's Rules engine lets you define conditions (e.g., query patterns, time windows) that trigger actions (promote, hide, redirect, boost) automatically, matching the core of 'define rules that trigger actions on events' but scoped specifically to search relevance/merchandising rather than general-purpose event automation (e.g., data pipeline events, webhooks, external triggers). Missing for 10: evidence of rules triggering non-relevance actions (e.g., notifications, external API calls), broader event types beyond search queries, and independent/hands-on validation of the rules engine's automation depth.
